types.name: Fire
types.description: Burns plants and melts ice, but fizzles on stone and water.

types.name: Ice
types.description: Freezes plants and cracks stone, but melts against fire.

types.name: Plant
types.description: Drinks water and splits rock, but burns easily.

types.name: Rock
types.description: Smothers fire and shatters ice, but erodes under water and roots.

types.name: Water
types.description: Douses fire and wears down rock, but feeds plants.
